fields.description: Montiva by Vida is a collection of one to three bedroom branded apartments in Green Gate, Dubai Creek Harbour. The proposed design pairs a sculptural tower and light-filled communal spaces with landscaped gardens, an infinity pool and a children’s splash zone. Park and golf-course outlooks form part of the developer’s positioning, with the actual view depending on the home.

overview: The brochure presents Green Gate as a landscaped residential district, with parkland, a central plaza and spaces for sport and play. Within Montiva, the emphasis moves to the lobby, shared interior spaces and the podium deck. This creates two different amenity scales: facilities serving the building and destinations distributed through the wider neighbourhood. A buyer comparing homes should check that distinction, alongside the size of the private balcony or terrace and the orientation of the selected apartment.
research.locationNote: Montiva sits in Green Gate within Dubai Creek Harbour. The brochure map relates the district to Creek Beach, the promenades, marina and central park. It also refers to future Blue Line metro connectivity; this is planned infrastructure, not confirmation of an operating station at the development. Travel times and walking routes require an up-to-date check.
research.priceNote: Emaar publishes units from AED 1,916,888. The launch fact sheet lists rounded starting prices of AED 1.91m for one bedroom, AED 2.82m for two and AED 4.01m for three. Actual available units and current pricing require confirmation; the published range is not a stock guarantee.
research.paymentNote: The launch sheet splits payments into 10% booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Its early dates have passed. Obtain a current unit-specific payment statement rather than treating the historic schedule as a fresh offer.
research.handoverNote: September 2029 is the estimated completion month in the payment document and is corroborated by Property Finder. Contractual handover and the latest progress remain subject to confirmation.

facts.label: Published residential mix
facts.value: 474 apartments: 234 one bedroom, 193 two bedroom and 47 three bedroom homes. This describes the launch collection, not unsold stock.

facts.label: Terrace area changes the comparison
facts.value: The one-bedroom Type 6A totals 1,260.77 sq ft, including a 441.21 sq ft terrace. The two-bedroom Type 4A totals 1,758.39 sq ft, including a 651.86 sq ft terrace. Compare suite area as well as the overall headline size.

facts.label: Three-bedroom arrangement
facts.value: The reviewed upper-floor plan totals 1,834.82 sq ft: 1,471.32 sq ft suite and 363.50 sq ft balconies. It includes a maid’s room, laundry, powder room and a separate master-bedroom suite.
